result.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
result.summary: Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery: identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal-oriented action replay following controlled error injection. Using ReTrace, we present the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery, revealing that (i) ideal recovery can unlock model's latent task completion capabilities, (ii) current computer-use agents fail to exploit their latent recovery capabilities, and (iii) accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains. Together, these findings establish recovery as a fundamental capability for building reliable computer-use agents. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReTrace 评测框架，在受控错误注入后用目标导向动作重放形式化「转移一致性恢复」准则，系统研究 computer-use agents 的自主恢复行为，并报告理想恢复可释放模型的潜在任务完成能力、但现有 agent 未能利用该能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文以「恢复态与目标态下相同后续动作必产生相同结果」作为状态等价的因果判据，并诊断模型 latent 能力未被实际调用，与 LVR 中如何界定 latent 状态内容、检验其因果作用及评测失败模式的具体问题可供对照核查。
